Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection (for unit 5) I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated 
by M6 in the title block.

The 
first draft is initiated by eng. Emad Mohamed El-Tohamy, tested by eng. Sawsan 
Elsaid Ali, reviewed by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Aly Moussa, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Sadik Ahmed: general manager, approved by eng Aly Anor El-Faumy, 
and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sherqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer "A" and 
MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued

Thee qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, etc.
Main CB 6kv off and rack it out and and lock it

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
6kv Circuit Breaker

Clean all external 
parts of the CB specially the insulators (the 6kv feed bars).

Check the switching on and 
switching off of the CB using the electrical circuit.

Grease the internal gear, 
the main spring using grease type SKF-63, increase the 
grease by hand to insure greasing all part, also grease the chains group.

Lubricate the following 
parts:
 a - The chain connected to the motor.
 b - The main spring.
 c - The inner gears group 
using oil SKF 63.
 d - Reverse the action group of the CB.
 e - The inner halls and openings using graphite 
oil.

sections.text: 6kv CB Cell
Clean the internal parts of the cell.

Lubricate the contact points of the ground switch 
by Vaseline.

Grease the mechanical parts of the cell base 
including the following:

a- The 
cell automatic internal damper transportation group.

b- Earth 
disconnect switch control group.

c- 
Internal axis, bars, arms.

d- 
Moving parts stopping group.
